# Publications

All `r nrow(pubs)` publications on my
[ORCID record](https://orcid.org/`r ORCID`), generated
`r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y")`. The live list, with research-theme
filters, is at [adamdennett.co.uk/publications](https://adamdennett.co.uk/publications.html).

```{r publications}
pubs |>
  mutate(authors     = vapply(authors, cite_authors, character(1)),
         title_venue = cite_venue(title, journal, doi)) |>
  detailed_entries(
    what  = title_venue,
    when  = year,
    with  = authors
  ) |>
  cv_italics()
```
